title: Co-branding
slide_intent: Teach designers to balance two marks with different outlines. A measured gap and an optical height comparison make the partnership legible without one name overwhelming the other.
strategic_value: Bolt can appear consistently beside distinct partners while accommodating descenders and irregular outlines.
demonstration: The same Bolt wordmark appears with Stripe, Klarna and REVOLVE in three rows. Each row marks the Bolt wordmark width as x and the inter-logo gap as 0.28x.
practical_value: Use the Bolt width to size the gap, then check a partner’s visible letter height and allow for small overhanging details.
